steps.question: What is the pleasantest thing a child can do?

questionMeaning.hi: बच्चे के लिए सबसे सुहानी चीज़ क्या है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachche ke liye sabse suhaani cheez kya hai?

options: to go up in a swing
steps.answer: to go up in a swing
steps.modelAnswer: Going up in a swing is the pleasantest thing a child can do.

modelMeaning.hi: झूले पर ऊपर जाना बच्चे के लिए सबसे सुहानी चीज़ है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jhoole par upar jaana bachche ke liye sabse suhaani cheez hai.

steps.question: What can you see while going up in a swing?

questionMeaning.hi: झूले पर ऊपर जाते हुए क्या दिखता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jhoole par upar jaate hue kya dikhta hai?

options: the blue sky, rivers, trees and cattle
steps.answer: the blue sky, rivers, trees and cattle
steps.modelAnswer: While going up in a swing, we can see the blue sky, rivers, trees and cattle over the countryside.

modelMeaning.hi: झूले पर ऊपर जाते हुए नीला आसमान, नदियाँ, पेड़ और मवेशी दिखते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jhoole par upar jaate hue neela aasmaan, nadiyaan, ped aur maveshi dikhte hain.

steps.question: What does the child see in the countryside?

questionMeaning.hi: बच्चा गाँव-देहात में क्या देखता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachcha gaon-dehaat mein kya dekhta hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The child sees rivers, trees and cattle over the countryside.

modelMeaning.hi: बच्चा गाँव-देहात में नदियाँ, पेड़ और मवेशी देखता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bachcha gaon-dehaat mein nadiyaan, ped aur maveshi dekhta hai.

steps.question: What does the child see going down the swing?

questionMeaning.hi: नीचे आते हुए बच्चा क्या देखता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Neeche aate hue bachcha kya dekhta hai?

options: the green garden and the brown roof
steps.answer: the green garden and the brown roof
steps.modelAnswer: Going down, the child sees the green garden and the brown roof.

modelMeaning.hi: नीचे आते हुए बच्चा हरा बगीचा और भूरी छत देखता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Neeche aate hue bachcha hara bageecha aur bhoori chhat dekhta hai.

steps.question: What does the child see when he is up in the air?

questionMeaning.hi: ऊपर हवा में बच्चा क्या देखता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Upar hawa mein bachcha kya dekhta hai?

options: over the wall, far and wide
steps.answer: over the wall, far and wide
steps.modelAnswer: Up in the air, the child sees over the wall, far and wide: rivers, trees, cattle and the countryside.

modelMeaning.hi: ऊपर हवा में बच्चा दीवार के पार, दूर-दूर तक देखता है: नदियाँ, पेड़, मवेशी और गाँव।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Upar hawa mein bachcha deewaar ke paar, door-door tak dekhta hai: nadiyaan, ped, maveshi aur gaon.

steps.sentence: Going up in a swing is the pleasantest thing.

meaning.hi: झूले पर ऊपर जाना सबसे सुहानी चीज़ है।
meaning.hinglish: Jhoole par upar jaana sabse suhaani cheez hai.
meaning.en: Going up in a swing is the pleasantest thing.
